concept: IAM: cross-account role with a trust policy
tests: How to securely give a partner's external AWS account time-limited, least-privilege access to S3 objects.
expected: Create an IAM role with a trust policy for the partner account; the partner calls AssumeRole and gets temporary credentials. Triggers: "external AWS account", "time-limited", "least privilege".
why_not: A public bucket exposes data to everyone; an IAM user with permanent keys — long-lived secrets outside your control; root credentials are never shared.
